system_overview: This module provides theorems for inductive proofs and recursive definitions based on well-founded orderings. It is part of the standard proof library used by the TLA Proof System (TLAPS). It defines well-foundedness, transitive closure, and the lexicographic ordering on Cartesian products, and proves that these constructions preserve well-foundedness. It also provides theorems justifying recursively defined functions over well-founded sets.
actors_and_components: There are no actors or concurrent components. This is a purely mathematical module providing proof infrastructure for reasoning about well-founded relations and induction.
additional_assumptions: This is a helper module from the standard proof library. Relations are represented as sets of ordered pairs. The module extends the natural number induction module. It proves that well-founded relations are irreflexive and asymmetric, that the transitive closure of a well-founded relation is also well-founded, that the natural number less-than relation is well-founded, and that lexicographic orderings on products preserve well-foundedness.
